APPROVE

The extracted `CompareSegment` keeps the same int, string and mixed-case logic. The mixed case always returns a nonzero value, so the caller's `if (c != 0) return c;` returns exactly what the old inline `return` did. Moving the `if`/`else if`/`else` chain out of the loop removes its nesting-weighted complexity, which brings `Compare` below 15. The new private static method uses only types and patterns already in the original code, so I see no new build warnings. I haven't built or run the tests here; this verdict rests on reading the diff.
